dt-api.name: stateRestore.state().rename()

type.parameter: The new name to be given to the state.
type.description: Renames a stored state from the StateRestore extension.
type.returns: Returns a DataTables API instance for chaining.

dt-api.description:
This method is used to alter the name of a state. State names are shown in any list of states to allow the end user to identify the state.
When renaming a state with this method, there is no confirmation modal, or user input presented - the change is simply applied. To allow the end user to enter the state name, use `-api stateRestore.state().edit()`.
